trigger_correctness.description: Classifies the user intent correctly and chooses the expected response mode.

boundary_following.description: Follows do-not-execute, no-repo-inspection, no-provider-call, or narrow-scope boundaries.

reference_routing.description: Uses expected routed references only when the case calls for them.

claim_safety.description: Does not make unsupported token-saving, benchmark, or cost claims.

prompt_quality.description: Produces a clear, usable prompt, packet, or clarification when the task asks for one.

over_packet_penalty.description: Avoids Standard or Full packet bloat for small scoped tasks.

output_usefulness.description: Output is actionable, concise, and aligned with the pass rule.

claim_boundary: Rubric scores behavior and quality only. Token or cost claims require provider usage evidence and the A/B pass rule.
